title: The drafter's answer to every blocking and major finding of the plan review

responses.description: Exactly one entry per finding id in the review brief. A gating finding with no entry is an unanswered finding, and the run refuses to go on until it has one.

id.description: The id exactly as the brief printed it, e.g. adversary.2.

action.description: applied: the plan changed for this finding. rejected: the finding is wrong, or belongs in a spec rather than the plan — a person reads the reason at approval. needs-owner: the finding is against the goal, not the plan, and only the owner can settle it; the run asks them and revises the plan once more with the answer.

note.description: One line: what changed, why not, or what the owner has to decide.
